summary.story: The Legend of Hei (Chinese: 罗小黑战记; pinyin: Luó xiǎohēi zhàn jì; trans. "The Legend of Luo Xiaohei") is a 2019 animated film prequel to the animated series, The Legend of Luo Xiaohei. It details various events in the life of the cat spirit Luo Xiaohei which take place before the series. A sequel titled The Legend of Hei II, was released on 18 July 2025 in China.
